Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the call earlier — really enjoyed learning about FinTech Inc.'s ingestion pipeline and data residency requirements. Per our discussion, the next best step is a 60-minute Private/VPC architecture review so our solutions engineer can walk through networking, IAM, and deployment options (on-prem vs. VPC) and we can align on the SOC2/attestation checklist.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Thu 2027-07-15 10:00–11:00
- Thu 2027-07-15 14:00–15:00
- Fri 2027-07-16 09:00–10:00

I'll include Dev Patel (solutions) and Mateo Alvarez (security) on the invite if any of those work. Agenda (draft):
- 10 min: recap & goals
- 30 min: architecture walkthrough (networking, KMS, audit logs)
- 15 min: SOC2 + evidence & timelines
- 5 min: next steps / action items

Let me know which slot you prefer or propose alternatives and I'll send a calendar invite with a short pre-read.

Best,
